corporate_action_reconciliation.candidate_policy: retain every candidate; never change eligibility, holdings, NAV or registry; merger disposal reconciliation unsupported

cash_exchange_contract.actual_coverage: no cash exchange in production registry; Jeisys actual payment evidence unresolved
cash_exchange_contract.entitlement: completed legal exchange; no successor; share_ratio=0; fixed positive KRW cash_per_share
cash_exchange_contract.known_gap_policy: config/kr_corporate_action_gaps.json blocks affected holdings from entitlement date; no survival exclusion
cash_exchange_contract.liquidity: receivable contributes to NAV but cannot fund target weights or costs; reject rather than scale targets
cash_exchange_contract.payment: payment_date and payment_source URL with payment_status=verified_actual; planned dates rejected
cash_exchange_contract.receipt: first observed session close on/after actual payment; zero turnover/cost and no second return
cash_exchange_contract.reconciliation: cash disposal candidate reconciliation remains unsupported
cash_exchange_contract.suspension: observed flat closes, original Volume=0 and exchange reference=0 required
cash_exchange_contract.valuation: nominal fixed receivable, no interest, discount, withholding, credit risk or partial settlement

corporate_actions.history_completeness: unverified; presence of registered events is not a coverage certificate
corporate_actions.merger_contract: stock-only succession with zero cash_per_share; mixed stock/cash mergers rejected
corporate_actions.split_contract: same code, shares_after/shares_before > 0, zero cash; event_date is trading resumption; exact primary market reference optionally separates exchange-price check from economic share return

split_market_reference.comparison: close / official reference - 1 at unchanged1bp; ordinary dates unchanged

split_market_reference.failure: missing evidence/hash/date/identity or same-day/future publication rejected; no inferred reference or broad exemption

stock_dividend_subledger.arithmetic: 50-digit Decimal book rejects inexact arithmetic; reference-price division is a separate rounded diagnostic
stock_dividend_subledger.cancellation: actual decision plus verified no-compensation evidence removes conditional claim and recognizes valuation loss
stock_dividend_subledger.certification: synthetic and evidenced_research books only; no investment/PIT approval
stock_dividend_subledger.economic_value: settled cash + tradable shares + locked shares + explicitly marked rights; never equated to ChangesRatio
stock_dividend_subledger.price_reference: Close / evidenced reference price - 1 versus ChangesRatio / 100; existing 1bp tolerance
stock_dividend_subledger.public_execution: explicit stock_dividend_contract required; real events remain evidence-gated; no automatic production registration
stock_dividend_subledger.quantity_policy: whole primary accounts unchanged; continuous synthetic fixtures or explicit modeled_research research_pro_rata, never legal fractional settlement
stock_dividend_subledger.receipt: actual credit moves approved whole-share rights into locked shares without second income
stock_dividend_subledger.research_model: optional DSL research v1: continuous pro-rata, explicit underlying-close share-equivalent haircut, date-only publication recognized next observed session, virtual settlement on official listing close plus declared session lag, before distribution tax; no broker credit/PIT certification
stock_dividend_subledger.rights: ex-date opening quantities only; separate conditional/approved rights survive sales
stock_dividend_subledger.scope: PROJECT common Gross/Net allocator with separate illiquid rights/locked-stock sleeves; research only
stock_dividend_subledger.tradability: separate actual listing/release evidence; locked shares cannot be sold
stock_dividend_subledger.valuation: explicit as-of unit mark, evidence and rationale for every pending right; no default close/probability

decile_research.tie_policy: composite_score ascending, then zero-padded Code ascending; ties may split

opt_in_event_pending_orders.events: Validated splits, stock mergers, fixed cash exchange, stock dividends and explicit simultaneous-listing research spin-offs; unknown events fail
opt_in_event_pending_orders.liquidity: all prior positive holdings and positive targets require observed positive close and volume
opt_in_event_pending_orders.orders: retain original target; no partial fills, cancellation, replacement, exclusion or cash advance
opt_in_event_pending_orders.rights: Ex-date opening holders only; cancellation removes right; listing creates tradable holding even after original-share sale
opt_in_event_pending_orders.scope: RESEARCH_ONLY continuous quantities, distribution taxes excluded; no actual brokerage settlement certification

opt_in_pending_orders.earliest: unchanged signal lag; old positions earn returns through actual execution close
opt_in_pending_orders.failure: overlapping pending orders, end-window pending orders, shorts or interacting illiquid action books fail
opt_in_pending_orders.liquidity: all prior positive holdings and positive targets require observed positive close and volume
opt_in_pending_orders.pending: retain original target; no partial fills, cancellation, replacement, exclusion or cash advance
opt_in_pending_orders.scope: RESEARCH_ONLY modeled close execution, not certified realizable brokerage fills

opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.orders: Both issued share legs become holdings before pending close orders; unpaid proceeds never fund buys
opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.scope: RESEARCH_ONLY continuous quantities before distribution taxes
opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.settlement: Virtual simultaneous parent change-listing and child re-listing close; neither actual account receipt nor integer/fractional cash settlement
opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.suspension: Every original session must observe flat last close, zero volume and zero/missing reference. Combined cum-right basket mark, not a forward-filled child price.
opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.unsupported: Non-simultaneous listings, intervening tradable parent, missing suspension rows, integer accounts, fractional cash/tax flows, unknown share terms or reference evidence fail
opt_in_simultaneous_spinoff_research.valuation: Frozen combined cum-right last observed value until joint listing; then retained-parent and new-child observed close values. No use of future prices during halt.
